label: Meeting Room
title: Meeting Room
subtitle: Brings multiple agents into a structured discussion. Agents take turns responding to a shared topic and the tool produces a summary with consensus when rounds are complete.
whenToUse: Use when a decision or analysis benefits from multiple perspectives — for example, asking three specialist agents to review a plan and produce a consensus recommendation.

methods.name: Start Meeting
methods.description: Convenes a set of named agents around a topic. Runs for a specified number of rounds or until consensus is detected. Returns a structured summary.

mediaCaption: A Meeting Room container in the chat showing each agent's contributions labelled by name and a consensus summary card at the end
tips: Keep the number of rounds low (2–3) to control cost — each round calls every participating agent once.
